item.title: About
item.description: From these quiet margins, I narrate a deeply personal story—my love-turned-entanglement with an ex-partner, the mother of my beloved two-year-old boy. “Deceit and Disease” is not an exercise in rhetoric. It is my confessional of intimate betrayals, a chronicle of emotional warfare, and a father’s struggle to reconnect with his son. Ahead lies a difficult journey. This is my sanctum, a refuge where I lay bare the wounds inflicted by a partner whose campaign of invalidation, and eventual marginalization eradicated my sense of self-worth.
